Name: Tidelight Harbor
Author: NogitsuneGurl
Description:
[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/5454d3d4-bdbd-437d-91c5-a1d87521236e_cb9c0e60dc88cfe7-compatible.gif[/img]

[size=6][b][color=#aaf0f4]🏮 Tidelight Harbor 🌊[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i]sea glass, driftwood and harbor lanterns… a cozy harbor home that glows after dark ✨[/i][/size][/center]

Hi hi! 💜 I made you [b]63 pieces[/b] of seaside furniture and lanterns for a lantern-lit harbor home and its back-alley night market, indoors and out, plus [b]3 wallpapers and 3 floors[/b] 🏡🌊 Everything is sold at [b]Robin's[/b], and in the Furniture Framework version [b]31 pieces have their own colored light[/b], with an on/off switch 🌙

[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/12c9d589-133e-44a3-be67-e0b68ac31561_fc2a5984ca2e5276-compatible.gif[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🧺 What's inside[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]💡 [b]31 lighted pieces:[/b] lanterns, sconces, a lighthouse lamp and a fire bowl, each with its own glow[/*]
[*]🐠 animated aquariums, gently swaying wind chimes and a crackling decorative galley stove in Furniture Framework · 🛏️ a real bed you can sleep in · 🧰 a sea chest that stores in Furniture Framework[/*]
[*]🐚 [b]New in 1.1.0:[/b] Sea Glass Wind Chimes, Shell Window Box, Harbor Welcome Mat and Dockside Boot Rack, plus upstairs house shutters and extra porch accents[/*]
[*]🏮 a whole night market for outside: gate, stall, noodle cart, fortune-teller's booth and wishing well[/*]
[/list][spoiler]
[b]🌊 All 63 pieces[/b]
[b]💡 Lights:[/b] Sea Glass Lantern, Paper Moon Floor Lamp, Jellyfish Lantern Jar, Lighthouse Lamp, Koi Lantern, Tidelight Lantern Garland, Anglerfish Desk Lamp, Harbor Fire Bowl, Driftwood Lantern Cluster, Faded Paper Lantern Tower, Mossy Stone Lantern, Market Street Lantern, Festival Lantern Line
[b]🖼️ On the wall:[/b] Glass Float Sconce, Scallop Shell Sconce, Moonlit Porthole, Moth & Lantern Wall Bracket, Fishing Net & Floats, Koi Streamer Banner, Old Harbor Map, Seashell Wreath, Shell Window Box
[b]🐠 Animated in Furniture Framework:[/b] Abyssal Jelly Aquarium, Tidelight Aquarium, Harbor Galley Stove, Sea Glass Wind Chimes
[b]🛏️ Home:[/b] Shell Canopy Bed, Driftwood Chair, Rope-Wrapped Stool, Scallop Shell Armchair, Driftwood Bench, Harbor Sofa, Driftwood Dining Table, Tide Pool Coffee Table, Sea Glass Side Table, Net-Mender's Long Table, Seashell Dresser, Barnacle Sea Chest, Driftwood Bookcase, Firefly Bottle Shelf, Great Wave Folding Screen
[b]🌀 Rugs:[/b] Lantern Market Rug, Koi Pond Rug, Braided Rope Rug, Sea Glass Mosaic Rug, Harbor Welcome Mat
[b]🏮 Night market:[/b] Back-Alley Market Sign, Alley Noren Doorway, Lantern-Lit Curio Table, Night Tea Stall Bench, Lantern Crates & Sleeping Cat, Fortune-Teller's Booth, Lantern Market Stall, Night Market Gate, Lantern Noodle Cart, Koi Wishing Well
[b]⚓ Harbor and garden:[/b] Harbor Buoy, Rope & Anchor Post, Stacked Lobster Pots, Potted Sea Kelp, Driftwood Succulent Planter, Sea Lavender Urn, Dockside Boot Rack
[b]🧱 Walls and floors:[/b] Driftwood Wainscot Wall, Night Harbor Wallpaper, Sea Glass Tile Wall, Weathered Deck Floor, Shell Mosaic Floor, Harbor Cobble Floor[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]🏡 Optional: Tidelight Harbor House[/b][/size]
A matching farmhouse in sea-glass clapboard with midnight shingles, driftwood trim, hanging lanterns and matching upstairs shutters. Little porch accents, a snowy winter look, amber night windows and individual colored lantern glows make it cozy after dark. Find it in the [b]Files[/b] tab under [b]Optional files[/b]. The decor works fine without it.
[list]
[*]It replaces the farmhouse look at [b]every upgrade level[/b] and comes with its own paint areas for Robin's paint menu at upgrades 2 and 3. Use only one farmhouse retexture at a time ⚠️[/*]
[*]🌙 The windows turn a soft amber at dusk, earlier in fall, winter and rainy weather. Each dangling lantern and colored glass float has its own little glow in its own color; the windows stay warm amber. All house lights follow the farmhouse and its upgrade when you move it.[/*]
[*]Snow in winter and the lit night windows can be turned off separately in config.json (WinterSnow and NightWindows).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Requirements & install[/b][/size]
For [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] with [b]SMAPI 4.5+[/b] and [b]Content Patcher 2.9+[/b]. Pick [b]one main file[/b]; the Furniture Framework version also needs [b]Furniture Framework 3.3+[/b]. Its included wallpapers and floors still use Content Patcher. 💾
[spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], then Content Patcher. Add Furniture Framework too if you choose that main file.[/*]
[*]Download [b]one[/b] main file: [b]Furniture Framework[/b] (colored lights, animations and extra interactions) or [b]Content Patcher[/b] (static furniture and base-game lights).[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. Back up your save and keep your config.json when updating. Replace the older Tidelight files, keeping the same main-file type you already use.[/*]
[*]Want the house too? Unzip [b]Tidelight Harbor House[/b] into Mods the same way, keeping [b]both included house folders[/b] together. The small house-lighting companion is included.[/*]
[*]Start the game and visit [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵💜[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]❓ Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]💾 Save/reload and updates from the published 1.0.2 furniture release are tested within each main-file type. The Content Patcher and Furniture Framework versions use different item IDs, so keep your chosen type on an existing save.[/*]
[*]🌙 Furniture Framework adds colored lights, animations, sea chest storage, the declared tabletop display slots and walk-through arch openings. The galley stove is decorative; cooking uses the farmhouse kitchen.[/*]
[*]🧶 Content Patcher keeps the bed, seating, dresser and ordinary table functions. Its sea chest is decorative, and its arches have solid base-game collision. The Tide Pool Coffee Table, Lantern Market Stall and Lantern Noodle Cart are display-only in this version.[/*]
[*]🏡 House not changing? Use one farmhouse retexture at a time. The optional house replaces Buildings/houses and its paint mask; custom farm maps are not covered by these tests.[/*]
[*]📸 The gallery uses game screenshots and labeled panels assembled in The Pixel Loom. The catalog shows the animated pieces as stills. The farm, rooms and kitchen are from the base game; the included decor is listed above.[/*]
[/list]
[b]💌 Sharing:[/b] Enjoy it in your game, screenshots and streams! Please don't reupload, sell or bundle the set, and ask me before sharing edits or reusing the art 🙏
